title: "Differential Expression"

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("R/read_manifest.R")
source("R/read_summary.R")
source("R/plot_helpers.R")

result_dir <- "data"
manifest <- read_manifest(result_dir)
```

## DEG Summary

Differential expression results are saved under `figure/deg/`. This section displays available DEG tables and volcano plots.

```{r deg-files}
deg_dir <- file.path(result_dir, "figure", "deg")
if (dir.exists(deg_dir)) {
  deg_csvs <- list.files(deg_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(deg_csvs) > 0) {
    cat("Found", length(deg_csvs), "DEG result files.")
  } else {
    cat("No DEG CSV files found.")
  }
} else {
  cat("DEG directory not found.")
}
```

## Top DEG Results

```{r deg-table}
if (dir.exists(deg_dir)) {
  deg_csvs <- list.files(deg_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  if (length(deg_csvs) > 0) {
    top_deg <- read.csv(deg_csvs[1], stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    knitr::kable(head(top_deg, 20), format = "html")
  }
}
```
